Name: Sunita Chauhan
Bio: Prof Sunita Chauhan is a Professor and Founding Director of the Center for Equitable and Personalized Health at Plaksha University and serves as Dean of Research. Her work has been featured in leading newspapers and scientific magazines. She has delivered more than 70 invited talks and participated in short courses and workshops in India and internationally.
Research_Summary:
Prof Chauhan's current research develops safe, intelligent robotic systems for healthcare and other infrastructure. Her work combines robotics, mechatronics, and AI for medical assistance, diagnostics, surgical training, and inspection.

Areas of work:

Medical and surgical robotics, including safety-driven design and control

Robotic exoskeletons and minimally invasive surgery

AI-based surgical training and automated assessment

Intelligent diagnostics and infrastructure inspection

Sports engineering

Robotics for agriculture, buildings, and other systems
